_comment: llama.cpp server config. Copy to llama_cpp_config.json and update paths. Reference numbers below were measured on an RTX 4090 (24 GB) with Qwen3.8-27B UD-Q4_K_XL; scale to your card.

qwen3.8-27b-mtp._comment: Text config with built-in MTP speculative decoding (needs an MTP-capable llama.cpp build). Measured on a 4090: 78-84 tok/s generation at 75-81% draft acceptance, ~1150 tok/s prefill. num_ctx 229376 leaves ~1.26 GB free on a 24 GB card; the full native 262144 also loads but with <0.5 GB headroom. Pairs with the 224_000 rung in core/engine_llama_cpp.py CTX_TIERS. Thinking-mode default effort is xhigh, which can deliberate unboundedly on hard structured tasks — structured-output callers should pass chat_template_kwargs {"reasoning_effort": "medium"}. No --cache-reuse (breaks hybrid DeltaNet state).

qwen3.8-27b-mtp-vision._comment: Vision config: same GGUF plus the ~930 MB mmproj projector (Qwen3.8 is a native VLM). Give it its own entry with --mmproj in extra_flags — that flag is how the request router detects vision capability and auto-reroutes image-bearing requests here. ctx is tier-aligned at 128K; on a 4090 that leaves ~2.4 GB free with the projector resident. MTP draft decoding runs during image requests on the same build.
